text: {"lessons":["A few periods of price changes are not enough to predict which way a stock will go; avoid reacting to short-term moves.","Selling Stock D at a loss and buying more Stock A did not guarantee a better result, so make trades based on a clear reason rather than recent performance.","Keep enough cash and diversify across holdings; I have a ten-year goal, so focus on steady decisions instead of trying to grow savings quickly through frequent trading."]}
